ProgramBench's October 22, 2026 documentation describes program reconstruction tests and warns that behavioral tests cannot cover all possible inputs [e1]. public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI, judged by Marcus's previously stated criteria, will not be achieved by 2029.

statement.excerpt: Gary Marcus stands by his own prediction that we will not see AGI by 2029, per criteria he discussed here.

our_interpretation: The post links to Marcus's May 2022 proposed bet, including a clarification identified there as added in June 2024.

The linked test requires one system to achieve at least three of five capabilities: explain a movie's characters and motivations; reliably understand a novel beyond its literal text; cook competently in an arbitrary kitchen; reliably produce more than 10,000 lines of bug-free code from natural-language instructions or interaction with a nonexpert, excluding assembly of existing libraries; and con…
I read 'by 2029' as through December 31, 2029, consistent with the linked tests referring to performance in 2029.
The reference to criteria defines the outcome; it is not a conditional antecedent that must separately occur.
Reliable capability requires repeatable performance across representative tasks. An isolated success does not establish it. Marcus supplies no numerical reliability threshold.
criteria.support_condition: After the deadline, a sufficiently comprehensive public evaluation record establishes that no single AI system achieved at least three of the five referenced capabilities by December 31, 2029. A lack of published tests alone is insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Public demonstrations and evaluations establish that a single AI system achieved at least three of the five referenced capabilities on or before December 31, 2029, with the breadth and reliability those criteria require.

evidence.explanation: The benchmark explicitly limits what its test results establish. Its coding evaluations do not themselves demonstrate Marcus's bug-free requirement or the required three capabilities in one system.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Early contradiction requires a dated, publicly inspectable evaluation showing one system reliably achieving at least three referenced capabilities. It must identify the system, version, tools, human assistance, task selection, and repeatability. After December 31, 2029, support requires a sufficiently comprehensive evaluation record establishing that no single system met the threshold by that date. Missing published demonstrations alone would not suffice.
